observations: A stack of approximately 13 PlayStation 5 console boxes in a retail setting.
The boxes show the 'Slim' chassis design, characterized by a horizontal slit across the side panels.
Most boxes are the standard white retail packaging for the disc and digital editions.
One box is a 'Call of Duty Modern Warfare III' bundle.
A watermark 'SOPHY GADGETS' is visible across the center of the image.
The background shows glass display cases with other electronics, suggesting a shop environment.

claims.evidence: The boxes in photo 0 show the distinct four-panel design of the PS5 Slim model.
While the boxes appear to be retail-fresh, the seals are not visible and the contents are not shown.
The storage capacity text on the boxes is too small to read in the provided photo.

risks.risk: The photo is a generic inventory shot from a shop and may not represent the specific unit being sold.
risks.proof: A photo of the specific box with a handwritten note showing the current date and buyer's name.

risks.risk: The console may be from a different region (e.g., Japan or USA), which affects the power plug type and Blu-ray region coding.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model number and region specifications on the bottom or back of the box.
risks.if_unproven: as the least desirable regional variant

risks.risk: The box could be empty or contain a used/damaged unit.
risks.proof: A video showing the factory seals being broken (if new) or the console being powered on and navigating the menu.

proof_requests: Photo of the specific box you are selling with a handwritten note of today's date.
Close-up photo of the box seals to confirm it is unopened.
Photo of the back of the box showing the model number (e.g., CFI-2000) and storage capacity.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a PlayStation 5 Slim from the retail packaging. Since 'brand new' and 'working' are unverified, it will be priced as a used, non-functional unit until proof is provided.
